---
title: "Pipeline"
---

End-to-end pipeline orchestrator that runs all analysis steps in validated
order.

## `sw_pipeline_run_all` {#sw_pipeline_run_all}

Run the full SpectraWeaveR pipeline.

### Usage

```r
sw_pipeline_run_all(
  fcs_dir,
  sample_meta,
  markers,
  lineage_markers,
  gating_template = NULL,
  gate_node = "lymphocytes",
  output_dir = "SpectraWeaveR_output",
  cofactor = 6000,
  n_metaclusters = 20,
  seed = 42,
  unmix_from_raw = FALSE,
  control_dir = NULL,
  unstained_fcs = NULL,
  control_file = NULL,
  cytometer = "aurora",
  unmix_method = "AutoSpectral",
  ...
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fcs_dir` | Directory containing (unmixed) FCS files. |
| `sample_meta` | Data frame with columns: `file`, `sample`, `batch`, `condition`. |
| `markers` | Character vector of marker names for batch correction. |
| `lineage_markers` | Character vector of lineage markers for clustering. |
| `gating_template` | Optional path to an openCyto gating template CSV. If `NULL`, gating is skipped. |
| `gate_node` | Gate node to extract after gating (default: `"lymphocytes"`). |
| `output_dir` | Output directory (default: `"SpectraWeaveR_output"`). |
| `cofactor` | Arcsinh cofactor (default: 6000 for spectral flow). |
| `n_metaclusters` | Number of metaclusters (default: 20). |
| `seed` | Random seed (default: 42). |
| `unmix_from_raw` | Logical; if `TRUE`, run spectral unmixing first. |
| `control_dir` | Path to controls directory (required when `unmix_from_raw = TRUE`). |
| `unstained_fcs` | Path to unstained FCS file (for AutoSpectral unmixing). |
| `control_file` | Path to control CSV file. |
| `cytometer` | Cytometer model string (default: `"aurora"`). |
| `unmix_method` | Unmixing method (default: `"AutoSpectral"`). |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to individual pipeline steps. |

### Details

Executes all steps of the spectral flow cytometry analysis pipeline in
validated order:

1. Load unmixed FCS files (or unmix from raw if `unmix_from_raw = TRUE`)
2. Remove margin events
3. Apply automated gating (optional, if `gating_template` provided)
4. Signal quality control (PeacoQC)
5. Batch correction (cyCombine)
6. Clustering (kohonen SOM / FastPG)

The pipeline follows the validated workflow described in den Braanker et al.
(2021) and Quintelier et al. (2021, *Nature Protocols*).

### Value

A named list with components:

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `unmix_result` | Unmixing results (if `unmix_from_raw = TRUE`) |
| `flowset` | Loaded `flowSet` |
| `gating_set` | `GatingSet` (if gating was applied) |
| `qc_results` | QC output from `sw_qc_batch()` |
| `uncorrected` | Uncorrected expression tibble |
| `corrected` | Batch-corrected expression tibble |
| `correction_eval` | Correction evaluation metrics |
| `cluster_result` | Trained `sw_cluster_result` object |
| `cluster_assignments` | Per-cell cluster labels |
| `cluster_mfis` | MFI per cluster |
